text_block_list.text: Nfuh~, you really captured the cute Umamusume's charm points so well~~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even as plushies, they're this cute...
Wait, are Umamusume just straight-up miracles?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Being able to exist in the same dimension as such Umamusume...
It's pure bliss rediscovered~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to you, Trainer~♪
